answer_1.quote: Training our corpus on NMT models, we outperform previous approaches to Bengali-English machine translation by more than 9 BLEU points and also show competitive performance with automatic translators.

answer_2.quote: To maintain consistency with previous results, we used lowercased BLEU as the evaluation metric.

answer_4.quote: We collected about 200 such article pairs and had them aligned by an expert. We had them post-edited by another expert.
answer_4.guideline: extensive manual and automated quality checks were performed, including expert alignment and post-editing, and automatic filtering for sentence length and quality.
